verdict.rationale: Fireworks publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 'Gateway REST API' spec that covers model endpoints under /v1/accounts. Its REST API is documented as letting you 'automate management of models', and it advertises an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so programmatic model enumeration is plausible from first-party docs. However, no evidence explicitly shows a GET /v1/models-style list endpoint returning the live serverless catalog. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented list-models / GET /v1/models endpoint, evidence that it returns the live public catalog rather than only account-owned models, and hands-on or independent confirmation of agent enumeration.
